spec.industry_level: first 2 digits of the classification code

frozen_criterion.rule: HELPS iff gain>=0.005 and |t|>=2.0 and LS net>0 and Q1 excess improves; HURTS iff gain<=-0.005; else WITHIN_NOISE

rank_arm_diagnostics.note: Q1 = within-industry losers; a large negative size exposure means the long-only excess is partly a small-size tilt, not pure reversal
